title: SIGN REGULATIONS
previewText: In Special Mixed Use Districts, the provisions regulating signs in C6-1 Districts, as set forth in Section 32-60 (SIGN REGULATIONS), shall apply for any sign. For the purposes of applying such regulations in Special Mixed Use Districts, all references to mixed buildings shall include mixed use buildings.
